mapper.select: SELECT id, report_code, field_code, field_name, field_type, field_form_type, width, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM report_definition_result WHERE deleted = 0 AND report_code = #{reportCode} AND field_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fieldCode}, '%') AND field_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{fieldName}, '%') ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE report_definition_result SET deleted = NOW() WHERE report_code = #{reportCode} AND deleted = 0
